title: First and last close
statementMd:
For each symbol show the closing price on its first trading day and on its last trading day.

Expected columns: `symbol`, `first_close`, `last_close`.

Tables: `tickers`, `prices`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: Join to the min/max dates, or use window functions.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT f.symbol, f.close AS first_close, l.close AS last_close FROM prices f JOIN prices l ON l.symbol = f.symbol WHERE f.trade_date = (SELECT MIN(trade_date) FROM prices WHERE symbol = f.symbol) AND l.trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM prices WHERE symbol = f.symbol);
```
